Questions Perth business owners ask us Straight answers on price, timeframes and what to expect before you hire anyone. How much does a website cost in Perth? Website costs in Perth vary widely depending on scope, design complexity, content, and whether you need e-commerce or custom features. WA small-business guidance recommends getting 3 to 5 written quotes and checking exactly what is included, such as content, images, hosting, and maintenance. How long does it take to build a website? Timelines depend on the size of the site and how quickly content and approvals are provided. One Perth agency says a standard website usually takes 2 to 3 months, including discovery, design, development, testing, and content creation. How do I choose a web design company in Perth? Check their portfolio, testimonials, communication style, and process, and compare several written quotes. WA small-business guidance also recommends asking for recommendations and confirming what ongoing support is included. Do web designers provide SEO as part of the website build? Some Perth web design agencies include SEO or basic search optimisation, but it is not always part of the standard build. It is best to ask whether SEO is included or priced separately before signing. Can I update my website myself? Many modern websites, especially WordPress sites, are built so you can edit basic text, images, and pages yourself. Some Perth agencies also offer training or handover support so owners can manage routine updates. Talk to a specialist Ready for a website that pulls its weight?
